standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Limits, lemmas descend-invertible-modules and descend-modules-finite-presentation (cross-chapter, named)
standard_prerequisites.use: Descend the surjections E_j -> I_j to some X_i after increasing i.

core_obligations: Upward: if X_i has the resolution property then X does, by the declared goes-up input.
Converse: choose i and a finite affine cover X_i = U_{i,1} + ... + U_{i,m}; take finite type quasi-coherent ideals I_{i,j} with complement U_{i,j}.
Pull the cover and the ideals back to X; the resolution property on X gives finite locally free E_j surjecting onto the pullback ideals I_j.

After increasing i, descend the E_j to finite locally free E_{i,j} and the composed maps E_j -> I_j -> O_X to maps E_{i,j} -> O_{X_i}; the source and target cokernels agree as quotients of O_X after further increase.
Conclude the image of E_{i,j} -> O_{X_i} equals I_{i,j}; by the carded finite-cover criterion X_i has the resolution property.
proof_roadmap: Upward by goes-up; cover and ideals on X_i; surjections on X; limit descent with cokernel agreement; criterion application.
difficulty_reason: A limit-descent argument paired with the carded finite-cover criterion; the cokernel-agreement step is the substance.
